# CIDEX 2024 — 苏州新维度微纳科技有限公司 (Suzhou New Dimension Nano Technologies Co., Ltd) — booth 2143

## Ringkasan

新维度是一家基于高精度晶圆级纳米压印技术，掌握多种微纳结构压印工艺的科技 企业，为下游器件企业提供设计验证、开发以及量产服务。 公司依托于对设备的熟悉、 材料的掌握以及对工艺的储备，可以进行多种工艺、多种晶圆尺寸的加工。

The technical team has more than 20 years technologies developing experience, which can develop the stable processing and high-yield manufacturing of various micro-nano structures. 3、Mass production line: ND-nano dedicates to the development of the low-cost, mass production technologies for micro-nano products, and the improvement of processing capability. NDnano always adhered to the main goal of reducing customer costs, and improving the industrialized manufacturing capacity for various micro-nano products and accelerating the development process of the micro-nano industry.
